_readme: Deployment settings consumed by `pac solution import --settings-file` for the
TST/ACC environment (Test and Acceptance combined — TAD ADR-006).
This file is NOT the provisioning settings file: the PowerShell scripts in
Purpose (C-TECH-031 / C-TECH-047): the managed solution carries environment
variable DEFINITIONS and connection REFERENCES with no values, so every
per-environment value is injected here at import time and nothing environment
specific is ever embedded in the artifact.
Identifiers only — never a secret (C-TECH-001). Replace every {{PLACEHOLDER}}.
ConnectionId values only exist after the service account has created the three
connections interactively (OAuth consent cannot be scripted), so this file is
completed as part of the manual connection-binding post_deploy step.

EnvironmentVariables._comment: Recipient of the Teams 1:1 notifications: new application (FR-009), borderline review (FR-019), daily summary (FR-021), failure alerts (FR-010). In TST/ACC this is the maker or a test mailbox, never a real applicant-facing address.
Outlook fallback address used when the Teams connector is unavailable (TAD §4).

Entra application (client) ID of the WordPress caller. The intake flow rejects any caller whose token does not carry this app id. Not a secret — a client id is a public identifier. Only required under the Entra-OAuth intake route (Dev Summary §7, decision D-1).
